description:
Natural Crystal and Geode Collection
Mixed Mineral Specimens and Polished Stones
Approximately 60 Items, Mixed Era
This comprehensive collection features a diverse array of natural geological specimens, highlighted by two significant geode slabs. The assortment includes raw geodes, polished specimens, and carved forms, making it an ideal starter set for a collector. The variety of colors and crystalline structures showcases the natural beauty of various mineral groups.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Large Amethyst Slab
- Purple crystal structure with natural rind
2.
Large Agate Slice
- Translucent with druzy pockets
3.
Red Jasper Pyramid
- Polished geometric form
4.
Mini Geodes (Bulk)
- Numerous cracked-open specimens
5.
Polished Gemstones
- Snowflake obsidian, green aventurine, and jaspers
6.
Raw Minerals
- Pyrite and smoky quartz chunks
Condition:
Good overall condition. Geodes are naturally fractured to reveal interiors. Slabs are structurally sound and stable. Polished pieces show smooth finishes with no significant chips. Minor surface dust present from natural storage.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland
Due to our lighting, white glare lines may appear on items - This is NOT damage
If you have any questions regarding the quality or authenticity of this item or general questions regarding and item, please click Contact Seller on the item page and send us a message. We are available to answer your questions Monday through Friday, 8 am - 3:00 pm, EST.

Some items may contain unseen flaws not noted in the description.
See Photos. Items sold as-is.

description:
Natural Specimen
Clear Quartz Crystal Collection
Natural and Polished Quartz Mineral
3.5" x 3.5" x 1.5" (Lot Dimensions)
Unsigned
This four-piece mineral lot features a selection of clear quartz specimens demonstrating various crystal habits and lapidary finishes. The collection includes a sharply defined double-terminated point, a large natural terminated crystal with complex internal structure, a polished point showcasing vibrant rainbow iris inclusions, and a textured rough-hewn point. These pieces illustrate the high clarity and characteristic trigonal crystal system of quartz, presenting a range of textures from pristine polished facets to raw, natural terminations.
Features one double-terminated crystal and one specimen with visible rainbow inclusions
Diverse mix of natural formations and polished geometric points
Specimens range from approximately 2 to 3 inches in individual length
Total lot weight of 1 pound provides substantial presence for display or study
Condition:
Good condition overall with natural internal fractures and inclusions consistent with mineral specimens. A few small chips and detached shards are present as noted in the detail photographs. The surfaces vary between high-gloss polish and natural matte textures.

shipping.policy:
1. Items from our selling location will ship within 5-7 business days (Excluding weekends & Holidays) from the time payment is received. We are working as fast and safely as possible to ensure all orders are shipped out in a timely manner.
2. We default ship FedEx & follow their packaging guidelines. Due to the odd dimensions of certain items, FedEx may charge more for shipping oversize items & calculate that into shipping weight as a "dimensional weight." Any special requests for alternate packaging arrangements may incur an additional handling fee charge to be paid before shipment. For more information on Dimensional Weight please visit:(http://www.fedex.com/in/tools/dimweight.html)
3. Paid for items will be shipped as specified within the order and will not be able to be modified or combined.
4. Items can only be combined prior to payment being received.
5. Items may be combined for shipping when the following criteria are present:
1. The items are from the same selling Goodwill.
2. The items close within the same week.
3. You have not already paid for any of the items.
4. The combined shipping weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
5. Items are not already in a fixed price flat rate shipping box.
6.
Can not combine Buy Now Items (due to system limitations)
6. If your auction items meet the above criteria, the site will prompt automatically to combine all available orders during the payment process. If the site does not automatically prompt please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry some exceptions may be made.
7. Goodwill Industries of Orange County will not be held responsible for items lost or stolen within shipping route once they have left our facility. Please follow up with carrier for these types of situations.
8. FedEx claims are filed on your behalf. We are not responsible for denied claims or delays on FedEx resolutions.
9. There will be a re-shipping fee for items that are returned to sender.

description: Collection of assorted tumbled and raw gemstones and minerals. Includes polished stones, rough minerals, heart and leaf-shaped carvings, geode slices, pearls, and wire-wrapped pieces. Stones include amethyst, rose quartz, aquamarine, obsidian, howlite, amber, agate, and others. Features a variety of colors, shapes, and finishes ranging from translucent to opaque and smooth to rough textures. Pieces are mostly small to medium-sized. Condition ranges from new to lightly used with no major damage. Suitable for collectors, jewelry making, or metaphysical use.

description:
Missouri Meerschaum Corncob Pipe Lot
2 Piece Set, Vintage Tobacco Smoking Pipes
Corncob, Wood, and Plastic, Approximately 6 Inches Long
A pair of vintage corncob tobacco pipes manufactured by the Missouri Meerschaum Company of Washington, Missouri. Founded in 1869, Missouri Meerschaum is the world's oldest and largest manufacturer of corncob pipes, known for their cool-smoking properties and historical significance in American culture. These two examples feature different bowl textures and stem designs, ideal for collectors or enthusiasts of traditional smoking implements.
Lot includes two distinct corncob pipes with wooden stems and amber-toned mouthpieces
One pipe retains the original factory label on the base identifying it as a Missouri Meerschaum original
Handcrafted construction utilizing natural corncob for a unique porous smoking experience
Sizes range from approximately 5.5 to 5.75 inches in total length
Condition:
Bowls show evidence of previous use with light charring visible inside the chambers. The exterior of the corncob bowls remains structurally sound with natural variations in texture. Wood stems are secure. Plastic mouthpieces are intact without significant bite marks or cracks. Base label on one pipe is present and legible with minor edge wear. Generally well-preserved vintage condition.

description: This lot includes four assorted raw mineral gemstone specimens in natural, unpolished condition. It contains two pieces of black tourmaline with striated, columnar structures and dark metallic luster. There is one greenish fibrous mineral specimen, likely actinolite or a similar mineral. Also included is a large rough matrix rock with silvery metallic flecks, possibly containing pyrite or mica, showing gold and grey mineralization. All specimens exhibit typical surface texture, minor chips, and some adhering matrix material. Sizes range from small hand specimens to larger chunks. No branding or manufacturer information is present. These pieces are suitable for collectors, educational use, or metaphysical purposes.

- Natural rough edges and matrix present on some pieces

The specimens vary in size and form a diverse collection of geological and paleontological samples.
